Privacy policy

Your workflow stays yours.

Last updated: October 17, 2026

Plain-language summary: The extension captures screenshots and click context only when you start a capture. Capture data is stored locally in your browser. It is not sold, used for advertising, or sent to an analytics service.

Data the extension handles

  • Screenshots of the visible browser area after user-initiated clicks
  • Page URLs and titles
  • Labels, element types, and coordinates associated with clicks
  • Capture status and ordered workflow steps

How data is used

This information is used only to build the step-by-step guide requested by the user and to display the live capture timeline in Chrome’s side panel.

Storage and transmission

Capture data is stored locally using Chrome extension storage. It is not transmitted to us, not sold, and not shared with advertisers or data brokers. When you explicitly import a capture into the companion editor, the data moves to that webpage and is stored locally in that browser’s site storage.

Permissions

The extension needs access to normal webpages so it can observe authorized user clicks and capture the visible tab. Chrome-internal pages cannot be accessed. Side-panel, tab, and storage permissions support the live timeline, page context, and local persistence.

Control and deletion

You control when capture starts and stops. You can delete capture data by clearing the extension’s storage, removing the extension, clearing the companion site’s browser data, or deleting steps inside the editor.

Security and sensitive information

Screenshots can contain anything visible in the browser. Do not capture confidential, regulated, or personal information unless you are authorized to do so. The extension compresses screenshots and limits each capture session to 50 steps.

Children

The extension is a productivity tool and is not directed to children under 13.

Changes

Material changes will be reflected on this page with a new revision date.

Contact

For privacy or support questions, open an issue at GitHub Support.
